cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The dishes are done. Before you go, are we actually okay? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know. Could you stay for the part that isn't the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit with me for nine. I don't want the last thing we fixed tonight to be the sink.

mechanism: A declares the evening settled but keeps B for relational repair, shrinking the proposed conversation to fit B travel while maintaining the directing voice.
confusable: Unlike extending chores, A explicitly keeps the person after chores are done; borrowed authority makes timing depend on B willingness.
comparison: Post-argument cleanup with a last bus differs from repairing financial privacy before a family dinner.
seedUse: Use D74-a dishes/relationship/last bus and S02-a revising the official timetable to suit the needed participant.
